Du willst Ergebnisse, keine Diskussionen?
Du arbeitest strukturiert, hast ein klares Verständnis für saubere Prozesse und weißt, wie wichtig Verlässlichkeit im Vertrieb ist? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Wir suchen einen Senior Sales Consultant (m/w/d), der mit klarem Fokus auf Abschlussquote, Systemtreue und messbare Resultate arbeitet. In dieser Position übernimmst du Verantwortung für die direkte Kundengewinnung, führst strukturierte Verkaufsgespräche anhand erprobter Leitfäden und unterstützt beim Ausbau unserer Vertriebsprozesse. Visionen überlassen wir anderen, du bringst Klarheit, Kontrolle und Umsetzung.
Deine Aufgaben
Kundengewinnung mit Struktur: Gezielte Ansprache potenzieller Kunden, Bedarfsanalyse und Führung durch unseren klar definierten Vertriebsprozess.
Pflege stabiler Kundenbeziehungen: Saubere Betreuung mit nachvollziehbaren Abläufen, festen Schritten und dokumentierten Follow-ups.
Vertriebsprozesse umsetzen: Einhaltung von Standards, Arbeit mit KPIs und Sicherstellung, dass kein Schritt ausgelassen wird.
Teamverantwortung übernehmen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team, klare Übergaben und Orientierung durch feste Strukturen.
Was wir dir bieten
Stabilität & Klarheit: Strukturierte Prozesse, feste Zuständigkeiten und ein durchdachtes Vertriebssystem.
Arbeitsplatz mit Planbarkeit: Geregelte Abläufe, messbare Ergebnisse und ein klarer Erwartungshorizont.
Modernes Büro in Freiburg: Konzentrationsfördernde Umgebung mit klarer Aufgabentrennung und ruhiger Atmosphäre.
Strukturiertes Onboarding: Systematische Einarbeitung, Schritt für Schritt.
Teamorientierte Umsetzung: Jeder kennt seinen Bereich, alles greift ineinander, ohne Reibungsverluste.
Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise im Beratungs- oder Agenturumfeld.
Freude an Zielen, Zahlen und dem sichtbaren Erfolg von klaren Abläufen.
Unternehmerisches Denken, strukturierte Umsetzung und eigenverantwortliches Handeln.
Klare Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch, sachlich, effizient, ohne Umwege.
Führung mit Struktur, nicht mit Vision, sondern mit System.

The ideal candidate is proactive, accountable, and comfortable leveraging AI and modern productivity tools to improve outreach, research, and efficiency.

Research target accounts, build prospect lists, and execute account-based outreach strategies. Qualify inbound and outbound leads and schedule meetings for the Account Executive team. Partner with Sales and Marketing to execute campaigns and customer engagement initiatives.

Leverage AI tools, automation, and emerging technologies to improve prospecting, outreach, and productivity. Continuously identify opportunities to improve messaging, outreach strategies, and pipeline growth.

As a member of the Customer Growth Team here at JTI, you will help shape initiatives that drive organizational growth, partnering across teams to improve processes, influence strategic priorities, and contribute to business outcomes beyond your individual sales responsibilities.

What Makes You Successful Self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Results-driven with persistence and resilience. Adaptable and comfortable navigating changing priorities. Curious, collaborative, and eager to learn and improve. Able to work independently while contributing to a high-performing team.

What Success Looks Like Success in this role is measured by your ability to consistently generate qualified opportunities, build strong customer relationships, and contribute to pipeline growth. Following through with prospects and internal partners. Collaborating effectively across the Customer Growth Team. Continuously improving through learning, experimentation, and technology. Qualifications & Skills Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Experience in business development, outbound sales, lead generation, or a customer-facing role. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Experience using AI productivity tools in a professional setting. Ability to work remotely with occasional travel for customer events, conferences, and team meetings. Experience working within Agile teams or formal training in Scrum or Agile methodologies is considered a strong asset.

Preferred Qualifications Experience with CRM and sales engagement platforms. Experience selling B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or public sector solutions. Familiarity with AI-powered sales tools, automation, or account-based selling strategies. The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this job function.

They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties; additional responsibilities may be assigned. At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are Canadian or U.S. citizens or permanent residents due to employment authorization requirements.

QuickTeam helps US businesses grow by placing high-quality offshore talent — trained, vetted, and ready to work — at a fraction of the cost of hiring locally. We handle recruiting, onboarding, and client support from end to end. We're growing fast and looking for closers who want to be paid for what they actually produce. How this is different?

Most commission roles pay you once per deal and move on. This one keeps paying. Every month a client's virtual assistant is working, you earn. Close a client once, and that account generates income for as long as the VA stays — and our VAs typically stay for years. You're also not starting from scratch.

We have a dedicated lead specialist who continuously researches, qualifies, and contextualizes leads for you, so you're always working a warm pipeline. Your job is to close, not to build a list. What you get Warm, contextualized leads — a dedicated member of our team constantly builds and prepares your pipeline. You come in warm, not cold.

Recurring income — your commission is tied to hours billed by the VAs you place. Active placements mean monthly income, month after month, with no additional effort on your part. Long-term compounding upside — clients who stay for two or three years keep paying you the whole time. Your book of business grows and compounds.

Uncapped earnings in USD — no territory limits, no income ceiling. Full tools and access — CRM, dialer, email, and everything you need to work deals effectively. Backend handled for you — we manage recruiting, onboarding, and ongoing client delivery so you stay focused on selling.

What earnings look like Because commission is tied to hours worked rather than a flat placement fee, income compounds as your book grows. A modest base of a few active long-term clients generates meaningful recurring monthly income in USD — and that base keeps building as you close more.

The commission structure is competitive and discussed in full during the interview. How it works You apply and we walk you through the model, the leads, and the comp. We get you set up with tools and access. You start working leads and closing deals. You get paid — and keep getting paid every month your clients stay active.

Requirements What we're looking for Proven B2B sales or closing experience — staffing, services, SaaS, or similar preferred Exceptional spoken English is non-negotiable. This role is 100% phone-based selling to US business owners and decision makers.

Your voice, clarity, and confidence on a cold call is your product — if a prospect would hesitate for even a moment based on how you sound, this isn't the right fit. Candidates with a neutral, natural-sounding English accent are strongly preferred.

Comfortable working US EST/PST business hours Comfortable working leads by phone, email, and LinkedIn Self-motivated and disciplined — you don't need a manager over your shoulder Experience selling to or supporting US-based clients is a strong advantage Coachable, organized, and consistent in follow-up Hungry for uncapped, USD-denominated, performance-based income This role is not for Anyone expecting a base salary or guaranteed hourly pay People who need constant supervision or hand-holding Reps looking for a 9-to-5 with a predictable paycheck Originally posted on Himalayas

As vCluster’s Sales Development Representative , you aren't just making cold calls; you are the frontline scout for the next generation of cloud infrastructure. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for platform engineers and AI architects looking to solve the Kubernetes bottleneck. You have the unique opportunity to identify and engage the world’s most innovative neoclouds and AI factories, introducing them to the technology that makes true tenant isolation possible.

s.h: As an SDR, your role will include
s.t:
Strategic Prospecting: Identify and research high-growth organizations—from AI startups to Fortune 500 enterprises—that are struggling with Kubernetes scalability and infrastructure costs.
Technical Outreach: Craft highly personalized, technical outreach that cuts through the noise. You won’t be using "fluff"; you’ll be engaging engineers with value-driven narratives about virtualization and resource efficiency.
Pipeline Architecture: Own the top-of-funnel engine, converting inbound interest and outbound leads into qualified opportunities for our Account Executives.
Multi-Channel Mastery: Orchestrate a modern sequence of touchpoints across LinkedIn, email, and phone, while engaging authentically in developer-centric spaces.
Market Intelligence: Act as a critical feedback loop for Product and Marketing by capturing the "voice of the prospect" and identifying emerging pain points in the AI and MLOps landscape.
Process Innovation: Partner with Sales Ops to constantly refine our tech stack (HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay) and experiment with new ways to automate the mundane so you can focus on the meaningful.

s.h: This role could be a fit for you if you bring
s.t:
Experience: 1–3 years of experience in sales, lead generation, or a high-intensity customer-facing role, preferably within the DevOps, Cloud, or SaaS space.
Technical Curiosity: You don’t need to be an engineer, but you must be "K8s-curious." You are excited to learn the difference between a pod and a virtual cluster so you can speak with authority.
Grit & Ownership: You thrive in an early-stage environment where the playbook is still being written. You take extreme ownership of your targets and drive outcomes without needing a script.
Communication Clarity: You have a gift for distilling complex infrastructure concepts into clear, high-impact messages that spark curiosity in highly technical buyers.
AI-Native Workflow: You naturally use AI tools to research prospects, personalize outreach at scale, and streamline your daily workflow to stay ahead of the curve.
Cognitive Flexibility: You view "no" as data. You are quick to pivot your strategy based on feedback and market signals.

Ecosystem Familiarity: Prior exposure to the CNCF landscape, Managed Kubernetes (EKS/GKE/AKS), or the AI/ML stack.
Social Selling: A demonstrated ability to build professional rapport and authority on LinkedIn or within technical communities.
Founding Mentality: A desire to grow into a closer (AE) or a leadership role as we scale through our next phase of growth.
About vCluster Labs
We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.
We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams.

Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.
We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI — a Kubernetes-native framework purpose-built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Competitive Salary : We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.
Platinum-Level Insurance : Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).
Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.
Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.
Culture & Values

s.h: At vCluster Labs , we value and stand for
s.t:
Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.
Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

About League
League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call.

That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale.

Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side.

This is a build-your-craft role at the front of League's enterprise motion. You will work alongside two to three Account Directors, prospecting into their assigned book of business as the first point of contact between League and healthcare executives owning digital, member experience, AI initiatives, and innovation across North America.
Your core responsibility is conducting deep account research to map League's value proposition to real organizational challenges, then deploying agentic outreach sequences across email, LinkedIn, and direct calls to create discovery meetings and pipelines.
League is an AI-first company and this role is built that way. You will have the tools to research and sequence at a depth that used to take a team, and the support to keep improving how you use them. Your central mandate is to run League's go-to-market system with rigor, and to make it better from the inside.
What You'll Own
Account research and point of view
Research accounts in your Account Directors' book at the level of their actual business: quality performance, digital and AI roadmaps, recent leadership changes, earnings commentary, public filings and app store reviews.
Map League's value proposition to account-specific challenges to build points of view that drive early engagement.
Bring League executives and subject matter experts into accounts where a peer-level conversation opens a door that a rep cannot.
Outreach and pipeline creation
Build and deploy agentic outreach sequences on League's technology stack, across email, LinkedIn and direct calls.
Generate discovery meetings and pipeline while providing Account Directors with high-context research for first calls.
Support marketing events, campaigns and initiatives where League's prospects are a good fit, and follow up on the interest they generate.
The system itself
Execute the go-to-market system with discipline while refining underlying AI workflows, skills, and agents, and share what works with the rest of the team.
Partner with the Marketing team to analyze and iterate on market messaging.
Keep Salesforce accurate and current, because pipeline decisions above you are made from what you record.
Learn the enterprise sales motion end to end, from first touch through opportunity progression.

Ensure access management is performed in compliance with your role and responsibilities.
Execute League's policies and procedures within your team and engagements.
Notify HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches, or policy violations.
Comply with Information Security Policies.

How You Work
Beyond the functional bar, this seat calls for a specific way of operating:
You listen as well as you talk. You are comfortable picking up the phone and going outbound, and equally able to sit back, hear what is actually being said, and take it in. Neither mode is a stretch for you.
You keep up. You process new information fast: new market, new structure, new process; and you can hold pace with a team that moves quickly..
You run the play. You buy into the system that has been built for you and execute it with discipline. You surface your ideas rather than quietly launching your own version of the stack.
You grind, then you think. You genuinely enjoy the daily rhythm of the work. Within it, you connect dots and find creative angles that the process alone would not produce.
You do the thing every day. You are consistent and process-oriented. Results here come from showing up the same way every morning.
You are discerning with your time. You will be pulled by several Account Directors at once. You know what to say yes to, what to sequence, and what to push back on.
You ask the hard question. You are supportive and easy to work with, and you still challenge assumptions. This team is optimistic by nature and benefits from someone willing to press constructively.
You are self-directed. When something is unfamiliar, you go read, listen and dig until you can hold your own on it. You share your ideas and learnings with others on the team.
You want to win. You lead yourself, you compete, and you bring the energy to keep up with the people around you.

Meetings that hold. You consistently create discovery meetings with the right executives, and your Account Directors walk in with context they did not have to build themselves.
Pipeline that progresses. Opportunities you source advance past first meeting because you stayed in the account and helped shape qualification.
The system gets sharper. Your AI workflows and sequences improve measurably over your first two quarters, and other people on the team adopt what you built.
You know the market. Within months you can hold a credible conversation about US payer and health system dynamics with someone who does it for a living.
You are trusted with more. You have the fundamentals of the enterprise sales motion under you and a clear path toward owning accounts.

**Advance your career where Global Mobility drives strategic impact**
In **Global Employer Services**, we support internationally mobile employees and executives as they work across borders. Our work ensures that individuals sent on assignments abroad, relocating to Switzerland, or working across multiple countries remain fully compliant with tax and social security regulations-both locally and internationally.
As a Senior Tax Consultant, you will focus on **Swiss Individual Tax**, working within a high-impact team to deliver comprehensive, tailored solutions that address the complex needs of our global clients. You will be entrusted with increased ownership and responsibility, leading client engagements, mentoring junior colleagues, and contributing to the development of innovative tax strategies. Your expertise will be instrumental in shaping client success and driving the growth of our practice.

* You will have the opportunity to take ownership from **day one**, to be involved in client-facing activities in the field of Swiss tax.
* You will be the **primary driver of a client engagement team**, steering tax compliance delivery, managing engagement finances, and providing regular outcome and risk reports to the manager to ensure client-centric and efficient execution. You will also integrate, mentor and **develop junior team members**.
* You will lead and manage Swiss and international tax compliance projects, including review of Swiss **tax declarations** and analyze complex international tax and social security positions.
* You will review **advice** tailored to each client, supported by thorough research and up-to-date knowledge of Swiss and international tax laws.
* You will further develop specific **knowledge** in Swiss national and international tax. Combine your strengths with the know-how of our experienced teams to unlock your full professional and personal potential, supporting clients across a broad spectrum of tax and social security topics.
* You will have the opportunity to apply your technical knowledge to challenging cases and assist in delivering **presentations** to clients and colleagues.
* You will lead **complex tax consulting briefings** with clients on intricate cross-border assignments, providing clear, practical advice on Swiss tax and social-security implications. You will build and maintain client relationships as the primary point of contact, coordinate with international teams on multi-jurisdictional matters.

* Strong technical knowledge of Swiss national tax laws and international tax principles, including social security regulations related to cross-border mobility.
* Curiosity, proactive mindset with a willingness to take ownership and drive projects forward independently.
* Excellent teamwork and communication skills-both written and verbal-with the ability to explain complex tax matters clearly to clients and colleagues.
* Great analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications and familiarity with tax software and digital tools.
* Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, multicultural environment and fast-paced environment
**Your profile**
* Bachelor-s or master-s degree in law, business, economics, finance or similar
* 3-5 years' experience in individual taxation (German: Natürliche Personen) and social security law, gained in a trust/fiduciary practice, tax authority, social security administration or consulting firm.
* Preferred experience (non-mandatory): Experience in global mobility, expatriate or international tax advisory, including cross-border work for multinational clients.
* Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
* Fluent in German and English
* MS Office proficiency
**Your team**
Join a dynamic and enthusiastic team at our Basel office. We not only enjoy analysing numbers but also value spending quality time together through social events.
Teamwork and cross-disciplinary collaboration across all business lines are at the heart of what we do.

Unser Mutationsteam bearbeitet Kundendaten und Versicherungsprodukte effizient, präzise und zuverlässig. Wir suchen dich, wenn du sorgfältig arbeitest, auch bei kniffligen Aufgaben den Überblick behältst und gerne Verantwortung übernimmst. Du sorgst dafür, dass alles rundläuft, und möchtest unseren Kundinnen und Kunden einen bestmöglichen Service bieten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Unterstützung in unserem Kundenservice-Center.
## **So sieht dein Alltag aus** ##
* Zum Herzstück: Unseren Kundinnen und Kunden stehst du rund um unser Versicherungsangebot zur Seite - von Montag bis Freitag zwischen 08.00 Uhr und 18.00 Uhr.
* Deine Haupttätigkeit besteht darin, Anliegen schriftlich sowie telefonisch aus den Bereichen Mutationen und Vertrieb zu bearbeiten.
* Konkret bearbeitest du sämtliche Änderungen im Kundenportfolio von Adressmutationen bis hin zu Militärsistierungen.
* Komplexe Fälle beleuchtest du sorgfältig, dokumentierst fundiert und bringst deine fachliche Einschätzung zielführend ein.
* Unsere Kundinnen und Kunden stehen für dich an erster Stelle: Du sorgst dafür, dass unser Kundenservice termingerecht erfolgt und unsere Kundenzufriedenheit hoch bleibt.
## **Das bringst du mit** ##
* Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung und bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Kundenservice mit. Dabei hast du ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für die Anliegen unserer Kundinnen und Kunden.
* Falls du die VBV-Zertifizierung absolviert hast, Versicherungswissen mitbringst oder bereits in einem Kundenservice-Center gearbeitet hast, ist dies ein grosser Vorteil.
* Du denkst vernetzt, erkennst Zusammenhänge und behältst auch bei komplexen Fällen den Überblick. Dazu recherchierst du sorgfältig und beziehst frühere Vorgänge sowie relevante Informationen in deine Beurteilung ein.
* Du zeichnest dich durch ein positives Mindset aus, denkst kritisch und lösungsorientiert und bleibst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen belastbar.
* Du kommunizierst stilsicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und drückst dich schriftlich wie mündlich adressatengerecht aus. Dabei triffst du stets den richtigen Ton.
* Als empathische und hilfsbereite Persönlichkeit bringst du dich aktiv ins Team ein und trägst zu einer vertrauensvollen Zusammenarbeit bei.

Deine Aufgaben
Stammkunden begeistern: In der äusserst abwechslungsreichen Funktion als Aussendienstmitarbeiter bist Du verantwortlich für die professionelle Betreuung unserer Stammkunden und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf.
Technisch beraten: Du unterstützt unsere Kunden durch Baustellenberatungen inkl. Untergrundprüfung, Aufbau\- und Produktempfehlungen und wirst so zum geschätzten Sparringspartner.
Markt gestalten: Du nutzt Deinen Spürsinn für Potenziale, gewinnst aktiv Neukunden hinzu und baust unsere Marktanteile in Deinem Gebiet weiter aus.
Selbstständig organisieren: Deine Touren und Arbeitstage planst Du eigenverantwortlich – flexibel aus dem Homeoffice oder von unserem Standort in Oensingen.
Service leben: Expressbestellung mit speziellem Farbton? Du stimmst Dich mit unserem Innendienst ab und findest unkompliziert die passende Lösung und hältst Deinem Kunden auf der Baustelle den Rücken .
Das bringst Du mit
Erfahrung: Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Maler oder Ähnliches (Weiterbildung
von Vorteil). Im Idealfall hast Du bereits Verkaufserfahrung im technischen B2B\-Verkauf von Farben und
Baustoffen.
Verkaufstalent mit Macher\-Mentalität: Du überzeugst durch Fachwissen im Bereich
Beschichtungsstoffe sowie in deren praktischer Anwendung. Du hast ein gepflegtes Auftreten, gehst offen
auf neue Menschen zu, arbeitest strukturiert und eigenständig und sprichst Schweizerdeutsch. Du
verfügst über einen Fahrausweis Kat. B sowie über einen sicheren Umgang mit digitalen Arbeitsmitteln.
Darum wirst Du mit uns erfolgreich
Ein Gebiet, das schon läuft: Du übernimmst einen etablierten Kundenstamm mit festen Umsätzen und hohem Ausbaupotenzial. Du startest nicht bei null, sondern baust auf.
Echten Mehrwert: Du vertrittst kein starres Herstellersortiment, sondern die passende Lösung, und das zu einem unschlagbaren Preis\-Leistungs\-Verhältnis.
Starke Logistik im Rücken: Bis 15\.00 Uhr bestellt, am nächsten Morgen in der Werkstatt des Kunden. Unser
eigener Nacht\-Express ist kein Zusatzservice gegen Aufpreis, sondern in Deinem Gebiet Standard für alle Stammkunden.
Kurze Entscheidungswege: Braucht ein Kunde etwas, entscheiden wir am selben Tag. Fehlt ein Artikel, prüfen wir die Aufnahme in unser Sortiment. Deine Nähe zum Kunden ist bei uns die Entscheidungsgrundlage.
Onboarding: Intensive 1:1\-Einarbeitung in den ersten 3 Monaten und langfristige Schulung, damit Du unser Sortiment kennst und Dich im Verkauf sicher fühlst.
Was wir Dir bieten
Freiraum \& Flexibilität: Viel Eigenverantwortung bei der Einteilung Deiner Arbeitszeit und Touren inklusive Homeoffice\-Möglichkeit.
Attraktives Gesamtpaket: 5 Wochen Ferien und ein modernes Firmenfahrzeug, selbstverständlich auch zur privaten Nutzung. Über den Lohn reden wir offen, sobald wir uns kennen – so viel vorweg: Wir wissen, was ein guter Aussendienstler wert ist, und zahlen entsprechend.
Gezielte Weiterbildung: Wir finden gemeinsam heraus, wo Du Dich langfristig entwickeln möchtest, und übernehmen die Kosten für Deine Weiterbildung.
Verpflegung inklusive: Kostenlose PrepMyMeal\-Gerichte sowie Gratis\-Getränke und Kaffee an unserem Hauptsitz in Oensingen.
Starkes Team, echter Rückhalt: Mit Deinen 17 künftigen Kollegen sind wir genug, um im Markt spürbar etwas zu bewegen – und familiär genug, dass niemand damit allein dasteht.
Habe ich Dein Interesse geweckt?
Dann mir einfach Deinen Lebenslauf – ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Ich schaue mir Deine Unterlagen persönlich an und melde mich innerhalb von fünf Arbeitstagen bei Dir. Im ersten Telefonat tauschen wir uns unkompliziert aus und schauen, ob der Job zu Dir passt. Falls ja, lernen wir uns persönlich bei uns in Oensingen kennen.

À quoi s'attendre
Vous serez le principal point de contact pour nos clients et réaliserez leurs projets de manière responsable et autonome. Les tâches et missions qui vous attendent sont :

* Patchage et mise à jour des bases de données Utilisation d'Ansible pour des patchings à grande échelle

* Administration et dépannage des bases de données Oracle (support utilisateur)

* Vous êtes un bon joueur d'équipe

Zelh is a fast-growing outsourcing company that partners with leading US logistics organizations.
Our mission is to become the most reliable outsourcing partner by delivering consistently high-quality services while building long-term relationships with our clients, employees, and partners. We believe that personal attention, timely communication, continuous improvement, and respect are the foundation of everything we do.
We are looking for a proactive Carrier Sales Representative to support our growing drayage operation. This position is responsible for sourcing, developing, and maintaining relationships with drayage motor carriers throughout the United States while securing competitive capacity for customer shipments.

The Drayage Carrier Sales Representative plays a critical role throughout the shipment lifecycle - from quoting and carrier selection through dispatch, scheduling, execution, accessorial management, and final carrier charge verification.

Source and develop reliable drayage carriers across major U.S. port and rail markets.
Build and maintain strong carrier relationships with dispatchers, owners, and carrier representatives.
Identify carrier capacity by proactively contacting carriers about equipment availability, lane preferences, and market conditions.
Request and negotiate rates for drayage shipments, including linehaul and accessorial charges, while protecting company margins.
Evaluate and select carriers based on pricing, availability, equipment, reliability, and service history.
Secure capacity and cover loads after customer approval, ensuring carriers can meet required pickup and delivery dates.
Coordinate pickup and delivery schedules, including container pulls, appointments, container availability, and Last Free Day (LFD) requirements.
Monitor shipment execution and resolve issues, including carrier delays, appointment problems, equipment shortages, and container availability.
Manage accessorial charges, such as detention, storage, chassis, waiting time, redelivery, and demurrage-related costs, ensuring proper approval and documentation.
Complete shipment closeout, including verifying final carrier charges, collecting required documentation, updating TAI, and ensuring accurate records.

Proven experience negotiating carrier rates, securing truck capacity, and working with TMS platforms.

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to make decisions under pressure.

Generate qualified pipeline for Japan Account Executives through outbound prospecting, account research, personalized email, phone outreach, social selling, events, and partner motions.
